aboutHero.subtitle: We are Legado Creativo, a multicultural brand strategy agency for businesses ready to build something that lasts.

paragraphs: Legado was built on a conviction: brands in the United States, and especially Latino-owned ones, deserve the same strategic depth that global agencies deliver to Fortune 500s, but from someone who truly understands them. Someone who knows both worlds, both languages, and both markets.

Victoria Urbaneja founded Legado Creativo to fill that gap. Not as another design shop, but as a strategic partner who combines business vision with creative execution, and walks alongside clients from the first conversation to real impact.

We believe a brand isn't built from design, it's built from clarity. When you know exactly who you are, who you're speaking to, and what you want people to feel when they discover you, design stops being decoration and becomes communication. That's what we do: help you find that clarity, then turn it into something that looks right, feels right, and is remembered.

members.name: Victoria Urbaneja
members.bio: Victoria Urbaneja is a journalist, publicist, and founder of Legado Creativo. With a background in strategic communications for global brands including Adidas, Novartis, and Univision, Victoria brings editorial vision, strategic thinking, and creative execution to every brand she builds. Her purpose is clear: to give the Latino community in the United States a voice, and to make sure that voice is heard with the same strength and professionalism as any world-class brand.

servicesFaq.title: Common
servicesFaq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with us

items.question: How does a project with Legado start?
items.answer: Everything starts with a conversation. You tell us about your business, goals, and audience. From there, we build a customized strategic proposal.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. A complete brand identity takes 4-8 weeks. A monthly content strategy can be ready in 1-2 weeks. We give you clear timelines before we start.

items.question: Do you work in English and Spanish?
items.answer: Yes. Everything we do is available in both languages, from strategy to copy and design pieces.

items.question: Do you only work with Latino brands?
items.answer: No. Legado works with any brand that wants to connect with the Latino market, the American market, or both. Our edge is understanding both worlds.

items.question: What does the revision process include?
items.answer: Every project includes defined revision rounds from the start so the final result is exactly what you need.

items.question: Do you offer support after delivering the project?
items.answer: Yes. We don't disappear when we deliver. We support implementation and are available for adjustments.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: Legado Creativo ("Legado Creativo," "we," "us," or "our") is a creative and brand strategy studio based in the United States that works with clients and collaborators around the world. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

By using our website or contacting us, you agree to the practices described in this policy. Because we work internationally, we aim to honor the privacy rights available to you under the laws of your country or region, including the laws of the United States, the European Union, the United Kingdom, and other jurisdictions where applicable.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Legado Creativo is the data controller responsible for your personal information. If you have any questions about this policy or how your data is handled, you can reach us at vickyurbaneja@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: We only collect information that helps us respond to you and deliver our services. This includes:
list: Information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, company name, and the details of any message or project inquiry you send us through our contact form or by email.

Information collected automatically when you visit our website, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages viewed, and general location, gathered through cookies and similar technologies.
Information related to a working relationship, such as billing details, project files, and communications, when you become a client or collaborator.

sections.heading: How we use your information
body: We use the information we collect to:
list: Respond to your inquiries and communicate with you about your project.
Provide, deliver, and improve our creative and brand strategy services.
Send administrative information such as proposals, invoices, and service updates.
Operate, maintain, and improve our website and understand how it is used.
Comply with legal obligations and protect our rights and those of our clients.
With your consent, send occasional updates or marketing communications, which you can opt out of at any time.

sections.heading: Legal bases for processing
body: Where required by law (for example, under the EU and UK General Data Protection Regulation), we process your personal data on the following legal bases: your consent; the performance of a contract with you; our legitimate interests in operating and promoting our business; and compliance with our legal obligations.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
body: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to keep the site functioning, remember your preferences, and understand how visitors interact with our content. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. Some features of the site may not work properly if cookies are disabled.

sections.heading: How we share your information
body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it only in the following circumstances:
list: With trusted service providers who help us operate our business, such as hosting, email, analytics, and payment processors, who are only permitted to use your data to provide services to us.
When required by law, regulation, legal process, or a valid government request.
To protect the rights, property, or safety of Legado Creativo, our clients, or others.
In connection with a business transfer, merger, or acquisition, in which case we will notify you of any change in ownership or use of your information.

sections.heading: International data transfers
body: Legado Creativo operates from the United States, and our service providers may be located in the United States or other countries. If you access our services from outside the United States, your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in the United States or other jurisdictions whose data protection laws may differ from those of your country.
Where required, we take appropriate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses, to protect your information when it is transferred internationally.

sections.heading: Data retention
body: We keep your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, to maintain our business relationship, and to comply with our legal, accounting, and reporting obligations. When it is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.

sections.heading: Your rights and choices
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:
list: Access the personal information we hold about you and request a copy of it.
Correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
Request deletion of your personal information.
Object to or restrict certain processing of your data.
Withdraw consent at any time, where processing is based on consent.
Request that we not sell or share your personal information (as recognized under laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act).

sections.heading: Exercising your rights
body: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at vickyurbaneja@gmail.com. We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law. We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your privacy rights.

sections.heading: Data security
body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against loss, misuse, and unauthorized access. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
body: Our website and services are not directed to children under the age of 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date above. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

sections.heading: Contact us
body: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact us at vickyurbaneja@gmail.com.
